name: google-apps-script-web-app-starter
description: Google Apps Script Web App Starter

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client && cp ./appsscript.json dist/appsscript.json
scripts.upload: npm run build && npx clasp push --force
scripts.deploy: npm run upload && npx clasp deploy --description "$(git log -1 --pretty=%B)"
scripts.redeploy: npm run upload && npx clasp deploy --deploymentId AKfycbw9GeYvnj5vrJ3UXBfIoHh3zkJTJcPl_rZ-0sJ9OqAK3FSkGMUlBoz3cKkoOTb9eG03 --description "$(git log -1 --pretty=%B)"

author: Ricky Wong
